Governor Stein Recognizes 44 State Employees With Governor’s Awards for Excellence

Awards recognize accomplishments and actions outside the scope of job duties

Raleigh

Nov 18, 2026

Today forty-four state employees from eight state agencies and four University of North Carolina System institutions were honored with the Governor’s Awards for Excellence during a ceremony at the A.J. Fletcher Opera Theater in Raleigh. 
“I am proud to recognize this year’s recipients of the Governor’s Awards for Excellence for their dedication and exemplary service to our state,” 
said Governor Josh Stein.
 “While these extraordinary employees may work in different fields, each of them is helping us build a safer, stronger North Carolina.”   
The Governor’s Awards for Excellence recognize accomplishments and actions that are outside the usual scope of job duties and represent the highest honor a state employee can receive for dedicated service to the state and the people of North Carolina. This year, awards are presented in seven categories: Customer Service, Efficiency and Innovation, Human Relations, Outstanding State Government Service, Public Service, Safety and Heroism, and Spirit of North Carolina.
“Innovation, bravery, and an overarching commitment to public service are just a few of the characteristics displayed by our award winners this year,” 
said State Human Resources Director Staci Meyer.
 “Their public service mindset is reflective of the values and culture we seek in our agencies and our state.”
A description of recipients’ winning qualities and videos that share their stories can be found 
on the Office of State Human Resources website
. 
The ceremony was hosted by ABC11 Eyewitness News anchor DeJuan Hoggard and featured remarks from Meyer and Laura Brewer, deputy chief of staff in the Governor’s Office.
